replies.author: OldManTigerMask
replies.body:
If you are the Original Map Creator or got the Original Map Maker's permission to use their map.
So basically Yes, your maps can be submitted here in Map Releases. However I should point out Avicus XML is not OCN XML. To find out more about the AVICUS XML (Atlas) go to atlas.avicus.net.
Hopefully that clear's that up! 

Thanks,
Tiger
